description: This file defines the VacancyAttachment entity class for the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It represents a database table storing information about attachments related to job vacancies, including fields for file data, metadata, and relationships to Vacancy entities.

classes.name: VacancyAttachment
classes.description: Entity class representing a vacancy attachment record in the database, including properties for file information, associations, and metadata, along with getter and setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the attachment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the attachment.

methods.name: setVacancy
methods.description: Associates this attachment with a Vacancy entity.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the file.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the MIME type of the file.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file in bytes.

methods.name: setFileSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the file.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Returns the content of the file, either as resource or string.

methods.name: setFileContent
methods.description: Sets the content of the file.
